in_marathi.name: Ujjayini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ujjayini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ujjayini means 'one who is victorious' or 'city of victory'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ujjayinī'.

in_bengali.name: Ujjayini
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ujjayini একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Ujjayini means 'one who is victorious' or 'city of victory'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ujjayinī'.
